title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Part 3 of 5 for issue #3: Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #3, then do ONLY Part 3.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): resolve URLs, inline styles, support SVG and shadow DOM (#3)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Resolve relative `src`, `href`, `srcset` to absolute. Inline same-origin stylesheets, keep cross-origin links. Mark SVG. Serialize open shadow roots. Build on `serializeNode` in `packages/recorder/src/snapshot/` from Part 2 and the serialized node shape from `@rewind/shared`.

Requirements:
- `srcset` with several candidates resolved correctly
- Shadow root child marked `isShadowRoot`

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Fixture tests: relative URLs, SVG, shadow DOM, stylesheet

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): resolve URLs, inline styles, support SVG and shadow DOM (#3)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" -m "..."`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and update docs/decisions/README.md.

Push to the existing branch `day-0
